recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, multi-layered composition featuring a saturated yellow header with heavy 3D block typography, a secondary text band on a blue field, and a candid group photograph of four men with a small propeller plane on a grassy airfield.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale 3D display type dominates the top third
Horizontal color blocking separates text zones from the photographic subject
The diagonal lines of the aircraft wings lead the eye toward the central group
High-saturation primary colors (yellow, blue) contrast with naturalistic outdoor tones
coreInvariants: Saturated yellow background for the primary title
Heavy 3D drop-shadow effect on the main header
Strict horizontal banding for information hierarchy

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures positioned centrally in the lower two-thirds, interacting with a small aircraft.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white 3D title at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down scan from the bold title, through the tracklist band, to the focal point of the group portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is packed with information and visual elements from edge to edge.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated Chrome Yellow (Background and Aircraft Accents)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Royal Blue (Text bands and Aircraft stripes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White (3D Lettering faces and Aircraft fuselage)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements creates a vibrant frame for the more muted, naturalistic photographic colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and heavy grotesque sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick slab serifs with a 45-degree isometric 3D extrusion
Secondary text uses ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif with tight tracking
Extrusion depth is approximately 15% of the letter height
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'C' characters in the main title are tightly kerned to overlap their 3D shadows
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast weight pairing between a decorative slab serif and a functional condensed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif skeleton for the main title.
Captures the density and proportions of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1960s style photograph of four young men in casual vintage clothing standing on the wing of a small yellow and white propeller plane parked on a grassy airfield under a hazy sky. The top third of the image should be a solid flat yellow block, and a thin horizontal blue band should sit just below it.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D white slab-serif title in the yellow section with a deep blue extrusion. Add multiple lines of condensed bold yellow sans-serif text centered within the blue horizontal band.

verificationChecks: Is the 3D extrusion consistent in angle?
Does the yellow background match the yellow on the aircraft?
Is the photographic grain visible and authentic to the era?

adjustableVariables: Width of the blue horizontal band
Number of figures in the photograph
mustRedesign: Specific band names and song titles

avoid: Contemporary sans-serifs like Inter or Roboto

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D text does not look like a modern 'bevel' effect.
Ensure the photo has a slight warm, vintage color cast.
Verify the blue band is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the slab serifs are thick and blocky.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a saturated yellow header containing 3D slab-serif type with a candid mid-century outdoor group portrait, separated by a high-contrast blue informational band.
